en: Color image showing a dramatic mountain valley with very steep, green slopes and a narrow winding road of sharp hairpin bends climbing the side of the mountain. In the foreground a group of tourists stand at a viewpoint beside the road, looking down into the long valley below. The scene is entirely natural landscape apart from the road; there is no visible printed text on the image side.
